escalations.title: The company web address now serves a marketing website instead of the inventory system, so the address the client was given no longer reaches the product.
escalations.recommendation: Point a web address at the inventory system, or say which address it should live at, and the readiness line that says the client can reach it gets re-checked against that address. Doing nothing means the system is reachable only at a temporary address, the client cannot be asked to start using it there, and one readiness line stays recorded as met when it is not.

escalations.title: The reviewing step is allowed to mark a readiness line as met, but not to mark one as no longer met, so a line whose proof has been overtaken by events stays recorded as met.
escalations.recommendation: Allow the reviewing step to mark a readiness line as not met when committed evidence disproves what it was passed on. The risk of allowing it is a delay; the risk of not allowing it is going live on a readiness score that counts a line which stopped being true. One line is in exactly that state today.
